title: Relation 类型增强：6 种关系类型 + evolvesKind + strength
action: 扩展 NowledgeMemRelation 类型支持 RELATED/CAUSED/ENABLED/PART_OF/PRECEDED/EVOLVES 关系类型，新增 evolvesKind 和 strength 字段
steps: 1. 在 protocols/nowledge-mem.ts 新增 NowledgeMemRelationType 枚举: RELATED|CAUSED|ENABLED|PART_OF|PRECEDED|EVOLVES
2. 在 protocols/nowledge-mem.ts 新增 NowledgeMemEvolvesKind 枚举: Replaces|Enriches|Confirms|Challenges
3. 新增 NowledgeMemRelation 类型: { from: string, to: string, type: NowledgeMemRelationType, evolvesKind?: NowledgeMemEvolvesKind, strength?: number (0.0-1.0), recordedAt?: string }

4. 修改 INowledgeMemService.createRelation 签名: 从 (fromId, toId, relationType: string) 改为 (fromId: string, toId: string, options: { type: NowledgeMemRelationType, evolvesKind?: NowledgeMemEvolvesKind, strength?: number })
5. 修改 INowledgeMemService.getRelatedMemories 返回 NowledgeMemRelation[] 含完整关系信息
6. 在 NowledgeMemAdapter.createRelation 中传递 --relation-type, --evolves-kind, --strength CLI 参数
7. 新增 graph.searchRelations(type) 方法: 支持按关系类型搜索
8. 更新现有 bridge (distillation-nowledge-bridge, conflict-nowledge-bridge) 使用新关系类型
9. 新增测试覆盖 6 种关系类型 + evolvesKind + strength
test_criteria: createRelation 支持全部 6 种关系类型
getRelatedMemories 返回含 evolvesKind/strength 的完整关系
现有 bridge 使用新关系类型不 break
